ja: • 国鉄で最も多く、708両も製造されたディーゼル機関車。
• 入換と本線の両方に対応した切り替え式の液体変速機を持ち、さらに重量総括、蒸気暖房用の機器（SG）を備え、全国の大幹線を除く全てに使われた。
• JR化された後もディーゼル機関車としては最大両数が現存。各種カラーバリエーションのほか、私鉄へ譲渡されたバリエーションも存在。
• JR貨物新更新色（寒地形）１両入り。
・動力ユニット5対応・走行台車T対応・1両入り
en: • Diesel locomotives are the most produced by Japan National Railways, with 708 locomotives manufactured.

• It had a switching type liquid transmission that was compatible with both shunting and main lines, and was also equipped with weight generalization and steam heating equipment (SG), and was used on all but the main trunk lines nationwide.

• Even after being standardized by JR, the largest number of diesel locomotives still exists. In addition to various color variations, there are also variations that have been transferred to private railways.
• Contains 1 car of JR freight new updated color (cold terrain).
・Compatible with power unit 5 ・Compatible with running trolley T ・1 car included
